title: Carr v. Mahaska County Bankers Association
shortTitle: Carr v. Mahaska County Bankers Association
summary: A reward concerning possible future bank robberies could be understood as continuing.
notes:
Casebook discussion of a shorter authority.

The discussion distinguishes a future-oriented offer from one responding to an existing emergency. Removal of the notice and adequate communication of revocation raise a separate question from lapse. Keep those two termination mechanisms distinct.

sources.label: Farnsworth et al., Contracts: Cases and Materials, 10th ed. (2023), pp. 240–242. Open assigned page 240.
